name: חֶצְרוֹ
summary: Hezro the Carmelite, one of David’s mighty men. His name is written חֶצְרוֹ in 1Ch 11:37, and in 2Sa 23:35 read חֶצְרַי (Hezrai) where the written text has חצרו. It is formed from חָצֵר, “enclosure, court”, or “settlement”, with a short-name ending; scripture gives no explanation.

evidence.note: חֶצְרַי (Kethiv חצרו) the Carmelite, among the thirty.
The root’s noun: חָצֵר, an enclosed court.

note: The 2Sa 23:35 token carries no BDB key in the database, so only 1Ch 11:37 is counted under h.fb.al.
